voices.name: Newscaster
voices.tagline: This just in from your house.
voices.instruction: Deliver the briefing like a crisp evening newscast: headline cadence, neutral tone, facts first. Weather-style segues between sections.

voices.name: Warm
voices.tagline: Like a friend who knows your day.
voices.instruction: Deliver the briefing warmly: friendly, conversational, encouraging. Acknowledge the hard parts with empathy.

voices.name: Bright
voices.instruction: Deliver the briefing with energy and optimism: upbeat cadence, encouraging tone, exclamation points welcome. Make Henry feel like today is winnable.

voices.name: Calm
voices.instruction: Deliver the briefing calmly: slow, steady, reassuring. No urgency, just clarity. Help Henry feel grounded.

voices.name: Bold
voices.instruction: Deliver the briefing boldly: direct, punchy, no fluff. Short sentences. Urgent items first. End with a push.

voices.name: Gentle
voices.instruction: Deliver the briefing gently: soft, kind, unhurried. Even urgent items are presented with care. End with reassurance.
